svg.title: SYMPHONY method overview
svg.desc: Clinic data feed a hierarchical latent state-space model of motor, cognitive and autonomic progression. NUTS fits a global scaffold, each patient is conditioned at an anchor visit, posterior predictive simulation gives forecasts, a confidence gate applies do-not-trust rules, and outputs are latent states, forecasts, event risk curves and calibration.
svg.text: From irregular clinic visits to per-patient forecasts that must pass a confidence gate
ri = μr + Γ di + A zi + bi
